summary: Two blocking spec-review findings remain valid and should be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: No-command skip predicate is underspecified
items.rationale: The spec must distinguish true absence of supported regression command sources from malformed configured commands or invalid discovery states.
items.evidence: spec.json R5 and T-4 currently say project regression command absence becomes skipped_by_project_policy, but do not name the invalid discovery cases that must remain invalid_project_test.

items.title: Skipped artifact proof contract is missing
items.rationale: The existing skipped artifact validator requires skipKind-specific proof, so the new skipped_by_project_policy skip kind needs a deterministic proof shape.
items.evidence: spec.json R5 acceptance lists result, skipKind, completed, process metadata, and raw log, but no proof fields for skipped_by_project_policy.
